7-yvucai]c]lO%GgwATm.text: ...so, you here about ALL_SPRITE? XDIf you're remixing this project to use the engine, you don't have to worry about this. HOWEVER, if you are going to be backpacking these sprites and dragging them to your own project, you will need to read this or else the engine will not work.Every time you drag a sprite from your backpack into a project, all the variables in that sprite become local variables (that means the variables only apply to that sprite). In this project, the variable ALL_SPRITE needs to be a global variable (applying to all the sprites in this game). So, you will need to delete all of the local ALL_SPRITE variables and replace them with one global ALL_SPRITE variable (not a cloud variable, though; that would be really messed up :P). After this, the engine should run just fine! :D(Don't worry about making your brodcasts global; they automatically are)
